description: The United States Wind Turbine Database publishes mapped locations and technical details for utility-scale turbines across the United States. The USGS data page states that records are assembled from public and private sources, checked against aerial imagery and refreshed as often as quarterly. CSV and geospatial exports can supply wind-asset locations, project information and turbine characteristics to generation, exposure or land-use simulations. Records lag installations and may omit new or poorly documented facilities, so a user should retain the release date, not treating a download as a real-time census. The own USGS page names the database, and the DOI registry states CC0. The ScienceBase DOI landing returned an access-protection page, while the independent USGS data page opened; a separate API base had a certificate error. I read metadata and article text without downloading turbine files or querying the API. No exact catalogue record was found. Related USGS turbine data services are linked from the own page, but the separate API endpoint was not successfully tested.
